tasks.gr8-democracy-and-human-rights-t3: Topic: Democracy and human rights. Cover constitutional rights, responsibilities, equality, dignity, and respect. Ask Grade 8 learners to connect rights with responsibilities, interpret case studies, and identify actions that protect or violate rights in daily life.
tasks.gr8-diversity-and-nation-building-t3: Topic: Diversity and nation-building. Cover culture, prejudice, stereotypes, inclusion, and ubuntu. Ask Grade 8 learners to evaluate attitudes in scenarios, challenge prejudice respectfully, and choose actions that promote social cohesion in schools and communities.
tasks.gr8-conflict-management-and-communicatio: Topic: Conflict management and communication. Cover mediation, assertiveness, listening, compromise, and problem-solving steps. Ask Grade 8 learners to choose constructive responses during disagreements and apply communication strategies that protect relationships.
tasks.gr8-physical-education-task-t3: Topic: Physical Education Task. Cover athletics, relays, indigenous games, flexibility, teamwork, and safe technique. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify correct preparation, fair participation, and cooperative behaviours during movement challenges.
tasks.gr8-hiv-and-aids-t3: Topic: HIV and AIDS (Grade 8 Life Orientation, Term 3). Cover what HIV and AIDS are, how HIV is and is not passed on, prevention, testing at a clinic, antiretroviral treatment and healthy living, caring for people living with HIV, privacy and ending stigma, and the National AIDS Helpline 0800 012 322. Non-graphic, factual, no stigma. Do not teach U=U. Ask the learner directly (you).
tasks.gr8-environmental-health-t3: Topic: Environmental health (Grade 8 Life Orientation, Term 3). Cover what environmental health is, how the environment affects health (water, sanitation, waste, air), the constitutional right to a healthy environment, laws and by-laws, Earth Day on 22 April, and planning an environmental health programme. Ask the learner directly (you).
